# Interactive Graphics
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(ggiraph)
library(palmerpenguins)
penguins
```

```{r}
# we can store ggplot objects
gg <- ggplot(
  data = drop_na(penguins),
  mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm,
                y = flipper_length_mm,
                color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 2)

gg

class(gg)

names(gg)
```

```{r}
# we can add layers to ggplot objects
gg1 <- gg + theme_minimal()

gg2 <- gg1 + labs(title = "Bill Length and Flipper Length")
gg2
```

```{r}
ggsave(filename = "scatterplot1.png", 
       plot = gg, 
       width = 9,
       height = 7, 
       units = "in")
```

## plotly
```{r}
gg1 <- ggplot(data = penguins,
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                     y = flipper_length_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(gg1)
```

! Be careful: Not all ggplot graphical elements translate to plotly
```{r}
gg2 <- ggplot(data = penguins,
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                     y = flipper_length_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Scatter plot", 
       subtitle = "Palmen Penguins Data")

ggplotly(gg2)
```

## ggiraph\
"ggiraph" provides sibling geom functions, e.g.:\
- geom_point_interactive()\
- geom_bar_interactive()\
- geom_col_interactive()\
- geom_histogram_interactive()\
- geom_density_interactive()\
- geom_boxplot_interactive()\

```{r}
gg3 <- ggplot(data = penguins,
       mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
                     y = flipper_length_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = sex))

girafe(ggobj = gg3)
```

```{r}
gg4 <- ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  aes(x = bill_length_mm, 
      y = flipper_length_mm,
       color = species,
      tooltip = sex)) +
  geom_point_interactive()

ggiraph::girafe(ggobj = gg4)
```
